concepts.name: The Design Floor
concepts.tagline: A space that behaves like the thing it sells.
concepts.description: A design-led format proposed from the returned reference places, where the physical expression carries the brand and the programming follows the space. These places were returned for the query; their design quality was not independently assessed. The reference selected for this direction is The Bell House (rated 4.5 by Qloo and popularity 0.998), described by Qloo as "Bar and performance venue in a former warehouse hosting comedy, music, and DJs, with two bars, pizza, and professional sound.". It was returned by Qloo for a Brooklyn, New York query; the location it belongs to was not verified.
